status: declared by the pull request that closes #524 (criterion 5, finding #515) before any variant was scored; reported only, nothing here changes the judge's declaration, a tier, a model, or any published figure; whether regime labels may be inputs at all is Eleonora's decision and this declaration does not settle it
question: what do the regime labels of metadata/evaluation_splits.json, whose boundaries were drawn after the fact, contribute to the calibrated stack (#475) and to the per-regime recalibration (#471)?
controls: the stack and the per-regime recalibration as declared (metadata/calibrated_stack.json, metadata/regime_recalibration.json), unchanged; they are re-scored in the same run on the same panel and cut-off rule

variants.no_regime: the regime term removed: the stack without its five regime indicators; the recalibration without a group (one pooled Platt curve per threshold and horizon)
variants.scarcity: the regime term replaced by the as-of reserve-scarcity state (scarcity.py: 0 to 3, or none), read at each forecast's decision instant, which is the state the judge's own splits use (pressure_judge._scarcity_states): the stack gets one indicator per state, the recalibration one Platt curve per state

everything_else: members, ridge, clip, refit blocks, fallback, gates, Platt constants and the judge's flag cut-off rule are those of the controls; no constant is searched
report: the judge's tiers 1, 3 and 5 under both miss rules for each control and variant; onset recall by year (2019 called out); the regime coefficients of the controls' stacks in 2019; what the hindsight labels contributed is the control minus the variant, stated with the judge's intervals where it has them
scarcity_state_note: states 0 to 3 are read from reserves as of the decision instant; the 2018-19 window is 99% state 3 (docs/pivot/setup-sensitivity-result.md), so the scarcity variant has little to switch on before 2020
